children: Reformation Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $155.23M and diluted EPS of $0.23, driven by continued direct-to-consumer and wholesale growth that supported a rise in net income to $12.41M versus $6.92M a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue grew about 24% for the quarter and roughly 27% year-to-date, reflecting expansion in both DTC and wholesale channels.
Direct-to-consumer sales increased ~21–25%, with active customers up 23%; DTC revenue per customer dipped about 1.4%.
Active customers reached approximately 1.2M and store count rose from 53 to 70, supporting brand awareness and distribution.
Operationally, the company recognized a $15M tariff receivable and completed a distribution center relocation, improvements that contributed to gross margin enhancement.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
